transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-09-10
Start: 14:00 PT
Duration: 45 minutes (approx)
Attendees: Maya Chen (Redwood AE), Liam O'Connor (Redwood SE), Priya Rao (CSM), Raj Patel (Bridgepoint AM), Sofia Martinez (Bridgepoint Sales), Ethan Wu (Bridgepoint SE)

Summary (auto-gen, may be rough): Quick monthly co-sell / pipeline sync. Reviewed top 4 joint opportunities (Orion Systems, Meridian Tech, NovaRetail, ZenithHealth). Discussed prioritization, exec intro cadence, security requirements for large health deal, and a short benchmark on Dedicated vs Hosted for Orion. Agreed on next steps: pricing sheet, benchmark, exec intro.

Transcript:
[00:00] Maya (AE): Hey everyone, thanks for joining. Quick roll call — Raj, Sofia, Ethan, you there?
[00:06] Raj: Yep, here. Thanks Maya.
[00:07] Sofia: Morning — or afternoon I guess — all good.
[00:10] Liam (SE): Hey team, Liam from Redwood, I can jump into the technical asks later.
[00:15] Maya: Goal for today is pipeline review and pick the top 2 deals to push this quarter, and agree owners for outreach and any tech follow-ups. Should be pretty light.
[00:22] Sofia: Sounds good. I'll run through our view on the deals.
[00:27] Sofia: First up, Orion Systems — they're a regional logistics provider, high volume, want near real-time ETA generation in their driver app. They've asked about latency SLAs and cost. They also are keen on VPC/private deployment for PII handling.
[00:40] Ethan: And they're also asking about model options — like can we do a smaller quantized model to stay fast on CPU and maybe use Redwood Dedicated for bursts.
[00:50] Liam: Quick note: Redwood Dedicated gives predictable throughput and we have VPC/private options for high compliance. For Orion, Dedicated with autoscale + KV cache should hit the latency SLOs; but we need a benchmark to be sure.
[01:10] Raj: What's the typical latency we can show? We need numbers to convince their CTO.
[01:15] Liam: For similar workloads we've seen p95 generation under 300ms for 512-token-ish responses on A100-backed Dedicated, but depends on model and quantization; on-hosted smaller models can be 400-600ms. I'll put a sheet together.
[01:28] Sofia: Great. Next is Meridian Tech — they're a SaaS CRM integrator, interested in embeddings and reranking. Main ask is cost per embedding and how caching reduces unit cost.
[01:40] Maya: We should highlight Redwood Optimize recommendations — we can auto-suggest batching & caching profiles that reduce embedding costs 40-60% for steady workloads.
[01:52] Raj: Any blockers there? They asked about SOC2, SAML — they want to see proof.
[01:57] Priya (CSM): We have SOC 2 Type II and SAML SSO in our enterprise pack; I'll share the security pack link after the call.
[02:05] Ethan: There's a deal — ZenithHealth — that's sensitive: healthcare data, residency in EU, and they want on-prem or private VPC with HSM for KMS.
[02:16] Liam: We do have an on-prem-ish private deployment and KMS/HSM integrations, but the presales work is heavier — likely needs legal + security review. Could be a salon two-to-three month cycle.
[02:30] Sofia: So prioritize Orion and Meridian for quick closes, ZenithHealth as long-term.
[02:35] Maya: Agreed. For Orion we should offer a pilot: 4-week pilot on Dedicated with a capped commitment and a joint SLA demo. Liam, you ok to run the pilot?
[02:45] Liam: Yep, I'll propose a pilot config: 2x A100 equiv nodes, KV caching enabled, 30k tokens/day target. I'll run a bench with their sample prompt set.
[02:55] Raj: On commercials — we discussed co-sell margin and referral fee. Can we standardize a partner price sheet so our reps can quote quickly?
[03:03] Maya: Yes, I'll send the partner pricing and co-sell playbook after this call. It'll include referral rates and recommended discount tiers for accelerated deals.
[03:12] Sofia: Also, prospects sometimes ask about fallback if Dedicated capacity is full — is there an automated fallback to hosted compatible model?
[03:20] Liam: Yes, smart routing can fallback to compatible model variants and we can define policies by latency or cost. There is a small perf delta but it keeps the app online.
[03:30] Raj: Good to know. One question from Orion — data retention and logs. They want audit logs per token and per-request traces for compliance.
[03:40] Priya: Redwood Console has tracing hooks and token-level cost/logging. We can redact PII and set retention policies per customer. I'll include docs.
[03:50] Ethan: Little typo from the earlier security doc — they asked if you support "sock two" — I think they meant SOC2.
[03:55] Maya: (laughs) yes, sock two is supported.
[04:00] Sofia: Timing — the CTO of Orion wants a tech deep dive next Tuesday. Can we lock Liam for a 1-hour session?
[04:08] Liam: I'm available Tuesday 09:00 PT. I'll prepare a short perf deck and run a light benchmark live if possible.
[04:15] Raj: For Meridian — they want an integration guide for embeddings into their search layer. Could we do a joint dev workshop?
[04:22] Maya: Yes, we can do a workshop. Priya, coordinate with Meridian's eng lead and propose dates.
[04:28] Priya: Will do. I'll loop in the enablement team.
[04:32] Sofia: A quick ask on procurement — some of our prospects request fixed-term commitments to get better pricing. Do we have standard reserved capacity templates?
[04:40] Maya: Redwood Dedicated has reserved capacity contracts; I'll include the term sheet in the package. Legal will need to review, so timeline may stretch a bit.
[04:48] Raj: Any red flags? I'm thinking ZenithHealth will want on-prem and HSM, that's a multi-team sale.
[04:55] Liam: Yes heavy, will need security questionnaire, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS, and possibly an onsite install. Be prepared for a longer procurement.
[05:05] Maya: Okay let's summarize action items.
[05:08] Maya: Maya to send partner pricing + co-sell deck by 2026-09-12.
[05:13] Maya: Liam to run Dedicated benchmark for Orion and share latency/cost sheet by 2026-09-24.
[05:18] Maya: Raj to coordinate Orion CTO intro and share availability by 2026-09-15.
[05:23] Maya: Priya to share SOC2 and security pack links and coordinate dev workshop scheduling for Meridian.
[05:30] Raj: One more thing — can we get a short one-pager on fallback policies and expected perf delta when routing to hosted? Our reps want to know what to say during demos.
[05:38] Liam: I'll draft a one-pager and include perf numbers; Mia, (sic) sorry Maya, I'll share it with Raj.
[05:45] Maya: Great. Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in email with calendar invites and artifacts.
[05:50] Sofia: Thanks, talk soon.
